label: EXPLORATORY_PILOT
research_question: Does the Track C Design A funding-trail QLIKE improvement over an RV-only baseline (headline E = -0.3579, session_20261118T093031Z) hold under an alternative chronological holdout (test 2024-09, train 2024-04..08) on the cached 2024-04..09 panel?

design.entry_origin_rule: origin at close of 1h bar t; features use only data available no later than bar t close (causal); trailing RV windows end at bar t; funding = latest observation with calc_time <= bar t close; a 24h-ahead target requires bars t+1..t+24 fully inside the declared window
design.target: next-24h realized variance from 1h mark-price close-to-close log returns t+1..t+24 (sum of 24 hourly squared log returns, dimensionless)

definitions.lrv1: log(sum of squared 1h mark-price log returns over trailing 1 hour ending at bar t + eps)
definitions.lrv24: log(sum of squared 1h mark-price log returns over trailing 24 hours ending at bar t + eps)
definitions.lrv168: log(sum of squared 1h mark-price log returns over trailing 168 hours ending at bar t + eps)
definitions.fund: signed latest funding rate with calc_time <= bar t close
definitions.fmean: mean of signed funding observations strictly before bar t (funding history trail)
definitions.fewma: EWMA of signed funding observations strictly before bar t, alpha=2/(min(n,168)+1)

features.standardization: train-only mean/std; zero-variance columns set std=1

model_family.type: stdlib OLS on log realized variance (HAR-style), normal equations + Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting; Duan smearing back-transformation on train residuals

evaluation.contrast: paired per-origin Delta QLIKE vs A_rv_only (A - model); negative = improvement
evaluation.uncertainty: UTC-day block bootstrap, resampled jointly across instruments, seed 12345, 2000 reps, percentile CI95
evaluation.robustness: leave-one-instrument-out (LOIO) mean Delta QLIKE vs A
evaluation.paired_test_origins: identical eligible origins across all models

materiality_floor: Mean Delta QLIKE (A - E) > 0 with bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0 on the 2024-09 holdout, to be considered a materially informative robustness confirmation; EXPLORATORY/PILOT only, no forecast-gate or confirmatory pass claim
sealed_months: none touched; 2024-04..2024-09 is the provenanced exploratory cache, not sealed confirmatory data
honest_status: EXPLORATORY/PILOT. Alternative-holdout robustness confirmation of an exploratory Track C result; no confirmatory promotion claimed.
